text: Side effects / stop signs: The most dangerous symptoms to watch out for are diagnostic of serotonin syndrome, which can be deadly if untreated: agitation + sweating + diarrhea + tremor/clonus + fever, confusion, fast heart rate, or unstable blood pressure. Other stop signs include less dangerous symptoms (some of which are part of serotonin syndrome, but not dangerous alone) like nausea, stomach discomfort, loose stools, headache, vivid or intense dreams, insomnia, sweating, tremor, anxiety, irritability, emotional agitation, or a too-bright / hypomanic feeling. And rarely, people report anhedonia that goes on for weeks after they stop 5-HTP.
